tools.name: generate_document
tools.description: Statelessly synthesize a publication-grade vector PDF document (invoice, estimate, receipt, credit note, contract, NDA, or real estate agreement) in under 25ms without mutating external server records.

tools.name: preview_document
tools.description: Statelessly render a 144-PPI PNG preview of the input document as a Base64 Data URI for visual inspection in chat without mutating server state.

tools.name: calculate_totals
tools.description: Statelessly compute subtotal, tax amounts, discounts, grand total, and balance due for a document JSON payload without PDF synthesis or server state mutation.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Read static subscription tiers, single-pass microtransactions, and checkout links.

tools.name: convert_document
tools.description: Perform stateless in-memory document transformation and PDF synthesis (converting an Estimate or Quote JSON into a new Tax Invoice, Receipt, or Credit Note JSON + Base64 PDF without mutating external server records).

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Perform stateless in-memory payment calculation and PDF synthesis (applying a full or partial payment to an input invoice JSON and returning a new synthesized Receipt or updated Invoice JSON + Base64 PDF without mutating external server records).
